title: 3 Day Luxury Fly-In Safari
description: Embark on an exclusive, all-inclusive 3-day safari adventure that leaps you directly into the wild heart of Serengeti National Park, followed by a thrilling descent into the majestic Ngorongoro Crater all without spending hours on dusty roads. After a scenic bush flight into the Serengeti, you enjoy game drives among roaming lions, elephants, giraffes, and vast herds of wildebeest. Stay in hand-picked luxury lodges offering gourmet dining, private decks and premium service. On day two you journey to the Ngorongoro highlands, with a vantage-point stay overlooking the crater, and end the safari with a crater game drive on day three giving you the chance to see rhinos, hippos, big cats, and a rich diversity of wildlife. Every detail is taken care of: transport, lodging, park permits, guides, and more. This package delivers maximum wildlife exposure with minimal travel time ideal for travelers who want comfort, convenience, and unforgettable African safari memories in a short timeframe.
highlights: Bush flight into Serengeti for quick access to wildlife-rich areas
Game drives in Serengeti: chance to see lions, elephants, giraffes, wildebeest and more
Luxury lodge accommodations private decks, gourmet dining, comfort & service
Visit to Ngorongoro Crater with crater-view lodge stay
Crater game drive (hippo pool, rhinos, big cats, diverse wildlife)
All main logistics included: transport, park fees, 4×4 jeep, guide, water, taxes, emergency fly-doctor cover
excludes: Personal expenses (souvenirs, tips, phone calls, etc.)
Tips and gratuities for guide and lodge staff

itinerary.title: Fly into Serengeti
itinerary.text: Take a scenic bush flight into Serengeti National Park. Meet your guide and begin an exciting game drive across the wildlife-rich plains, home to lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, and wildebeest.Enjoy an afternoon and sunset game drive before checking into your luxury lodge for a relaxing evening and gourmet dinner.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxury Serengeti LodgeMeal Plan: Lunch & Dinner

itinerary.title: Serengeti Morning Game Drive – Transfer to Ngorongoro
itinerary.text: After breakfast, head out for a morning game drive as wildlife activity peaks. Later, depart Serengeti and travel to the Ngorongoro Highlands. Arrive at your crater-rim lodge with stunning views of the Ngorongoro Crater.
itinerary.accommodation: Luxury Crater-Rim LodgeMeal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive – Departure
itinerary.text: Descend into the Ngorongoro Crater for a memorable game drive, with opportunities to spot elephants, buffalo, lions, hippos, and possibly the black rhino. After a picnic lunch, ascend the crater and transfer to the airstrip or Arusha for your onward journey. Meal Plan: Breakfast & Lunch
